paragraphs: Simplifyance sells a single system for compliance, training, and HR, described on the homepage as purpose-built for behavioral health. The platform is organised as compliance and risk, training and learning, and HR and workforce, with credentials and HR files connected to compliance workflows. Training is built in rather than run as a separate LMS, and state and accreditation modules sit alongside a course library and completion tracking.

Alongside the software, the company sells licensing, implementation, and advisory, including survey prep for CARF, Joint Commission, and state licensure. Platform licensing is offered as full-system access for every site, covering compliance, training, HR, and reporting in one license.
Simplifyance sorts its market into multi-site operators and PE-backed groups, growing organizations with 10 to 50 programs, and single-site and small programs.

quote.text: Compliance, training, and HR in one system
